metadata.title: PVTG - आदिवासी अस्तित्व का संघर्ष | Xaxa Report episode - 3 | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: PVTG or Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups are the groups who are fighting for their survival. In this they are facing various difficulties, for which they still lag behind even among tribals. Why is it so? and what challenges are they facing? Prof. Virginius Xaxa led committee had mentioned these in his detailed report. We have covered their problems, issues and proposed recommendations to save and uplift their lives.
